[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Agent history for a model alias in Launch Control[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pressing `H` on any alias-bearing Launch Control row opens a pop-up[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]panel that answers "which agents actually ran on this alias, and [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]snippet, and an honest provenance chip that distinguishes a direct [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`%model:@alias` request from an alias reached through another alias[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and from the no-directive default, backed by a new per-alias [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]retention limit config field.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Record the alias resolution trail and its origin at launch[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]provenance[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]provenance: make alias resolution return the ordered trail of alias hops[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]it traversed, give LaunchSelection that trail plus the origin of the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]request (directive vs no-directive default vs no alias), and persist [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`model_alias_trail` and `model_alias_origin` into agent_meta.json and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prompt-step markers at every launch, reconcile, re-exec, and follow-up [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]write site.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust core — alias projection, schema 22, and the alias-history[bold white on #D75F87][/bold #D7AFFF] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]query[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]and PromptStepMarkerWire, project each run's trail into a new normalized[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]agent_artifact_model_aliases table under artifact-index schema 22 with a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record_json re-projection migration that backfills legacy rows, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]expose a bounded `query_agent_alias_history` PyO3 binding that returns [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per-alias groups with truncation counts and a directive-stripped prompt [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snippet.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]trail/origin on the marker wires, a new agent_alias_history_wire module [/#D7D7AF]
